review_basis: Final native-size labeled sheet and final contact sheet; head muzzle, eyes, cheek occlusion, anchored torso and bamboo.

000.observed: Head pitches upward with centered high nose and raised chin.
000.evidence: Nostrils face viewer from below, muzzle lies above eye-patch lower edges, eyes aim upward; torso, bamboo and feet stay planted.

022.5.observed: Strong up pitch plus modest right yaw.
022.5.evidence: Nose shifts right from centered up anchor while chin remains raised and eyes aim high right; both ears and full front body remain visible.

045.observed: Up-right head turn, similar to previous pose.
045.evidence: Muzzle projects right, far cheek is partly occluded and nose remains high with raised chin. Similarity to 022.5 is minor; intended quadrant remains clear.

067.5.observed: Mostly right with slight upward pitch.
067.5.evidence: Nose projects toward screen-right and upper muzzle remains lifted; gaze is higher than level right anchor, anchored body unchanged.

090.observed: Clear level head yaw toward screen-right.
090.evidence: Nose and open muzzle project on right edge of head, near eye visible and far eye partly occluded, feet and bamboo remain frontal.

112.5.observed: Rightward yaw with lowered head and eyes.
112.5.evidence: Nose remains right of head center but drops toward bamboo compared with 090; brow overhang and reduced raised chin show down pitch.

135.observed: Head bows and turns diagonally down-right.
135.evidence: Top of head dominates, nose lies low toward right paw, near eye looks down/right; front torso and bamboo stay anchored.

157.5.observed: Strong bowed head with subtle remaining right yaw.
157.5.evidence: Low nose aims toward bamboo slightly right of head midline; right cheek foreshortening retains horizontal cue while both eyes sit low under brow.

180.observed: Centered bowed head looking directly down at bamboo.
180.evidence: Large visible forehead, both eyes tucked under low brow, centered nose near bamboo and chin lowered; no horizontal head yaw.

202.5.observed: Downward bow with modest left yaw.
202.5.evidence: Nose shifts left of forehead midline and remains low near left paw; eyes remain directed down while far cheek begins occlusion.

225.evidence: Muzzle projects left toward bamboo, visible forehead indicates downward pitch, far eye occluded by leftward head yaw.

247.5.observed: Mostly left with slightly lowered muzzle.
247.5.evidence: Nose projects left and mouth points below the level left cardinal; eyes and brow incline toward the lower-left region without moving feet.

270.evidence: Nose on left edge of face, near dark eye visible and far eye occluded; muzzle horizontal left while body remains frontal.

292.5.observed: Leftward head yaw and visibly raised chin.
292.5.evidence: Nose remains left of head center while muzzle rises and chin opens upward; glossy near eye points toward upper-left.

315.observed: Up-left head turn with high nose and lifted chin.
315.evidence: Left-projecting nose is above level-left anchor, upper gaze and exposed underside of muzzle show upward pitch; torso and bamboo fixed.

337.5.observed: High upward gaze with left yaw still fairly pronounced.
337.5.evidence: Nose stays left of center and raised, chin lifted and eyes high left. Similarity to 315 is minor and the following centered-up pose keeps the ordered quadrant sweep.

continuity_review.natural_transparency: Warnings at y195-197 are the open background gap between the two rounded feet below the belly, visible in every source pose; not an enclosed hole or cut across the body.
continuity_review.boundary_157_180: The 6.5px bounding-center change follows the broader frontal bowed forehead in 180; foot baseline, bamboo and body remain stable, without broken attachment or clipping.
continuity_review.boundary_337_000: Head yaw returns from left to centered upward; chin remains lifted and torso planted. No direction reversal or identity break.
continuity_review.state_motion: Nine standard rows preserve complete body and prop connection; jump departs and returns to the idle baseline with comparable body size. Gait alternates and work row nibbles bamboo while seated.
